summary: Benewah County, ID tower with an L-4 cab, recorded 1937 and destroyed 1953; a 2025 visit found footings and 1956 benchmarks, no standing structure.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1953; a 2025 visit found footings and benchmarks but no tower

access.note: The 2025 visit was a short hike up from the road; no closure is described in the sources read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts calls the site Pettis Point Lookout, while firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts use Pettis Peak. The record keeps Pettis Peak and notes the other name.

notes_for_editor: Access is marked public by inference: the 2025 visit was a short walk from the road and no source describes a closure; confirm before relying on it. The Idaho Fire Lookouts post does not clearly tie the footings to the 1937 tower, and it doubts the 1956 benchmark dates against the 1953 destruction; the story says so. Name differs (Pettis Peak vs Pettis Point). No photos added. No staffing history exists in any source read; the story leaves staffing out.
